mapper.select: SELECT INSTRUMENT_ID, INSTRUMENT_NO, BILL_NO, BILL_TYPE, BILL_AMOUNT, CURRENCY_CODE, DRAWER, DRAWER_ACCOUNT, PAYEE, PAYEE_ACCOUNT, ACCEPTOR, ACCEPTOR_ACCOUNT, ISSUE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, BILL_STATUS, DELETE_FLAG, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE INSTRUMENT_ID = #{instrumentId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(AVG(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS avgAmount, COALESCE(MAX(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS maxAmount, COALESCE(MIN(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS minAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN BILL_STATUS IN ('NORMAL', 'VALID', 'ACTIVE', 'HOLDING', '已开立', '已承兑') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount FROM ( SELECT BILL_AMOUNT, BILL_STATUS FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT BILL_AMOUNT, BILL_STATUS FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 ) combined

SELECT BILL_TYPE AS billType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT BILL_TYPE, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT BILL_TYPE, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 ) combined GROUP BY BILL_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT BILL_STATUS AS billStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT BILL_STATUS, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT BILL_STATUS, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 ) combined GROUP BY BILL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ACCEPTOR AS acceptor, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT ACCEPTOR, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ACCEPTOR IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ACCEPTING_BANK AS ACCEPTOR, BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ACCEPTING_BANK IS NOT NULL ) combined GROUP BY ACCEPTOR ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN BILL_AMOUNT < 100000 THEN '10万以下' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 100000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 500000 THEN '10-50万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 500000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 1000000 THEN '50-100万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 1000000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 5000000 THEN '100-500万' ELSE '500万以上' END AS amountRange, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 UNION ALL SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 ) combined GROUP BY CASE WHEN BILL_AMOUNT < 100000 THEN '10万以下' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 100000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 500000 THEN '10-50万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 500000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 1000000 THEN '50-100万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 1000000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 5000000 THEN '100-500万' ELSE '500万以上' END ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND CREATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') UNION ALL SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND CREATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ) combined

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_INSTRUMENT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') UNION ALL SELECT BILL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ) combined
